limits: Finite static, zero-output measurements do not validate standing, Trot, disturbance recovery or closed-loop stability.
Affinity also changes ondemand frequency distributions; effects cannot be uniquely assigned to affinity.
Adopted policy age excludes full observation/solve/application latency; original 40ms gate preserved.
Both WBC paths use the new matrix buffers/timers; the comparison does not measure all changes versus original HEAD.
SQProblem H/A updates can still require matrix factorization; zero working-set iterations in these stance windows do not establish runtime savings.
NMPC node profiling adds timer overhead; parallel accumulated CPU/wall sums are not complete solve wall time.
IO decoupling and multi-rate architecture were assessed but not implemented.
Recorder initially rejected one complete split window with stale policies; retained data were resumed after adjusting only outcome reporting, not the controller gate.
